settings.admin.backfill.contractor.cloud: Cloud unavailable — only local records were processed.
settings.admin.backfill.contractor.intro: Writes UUID contractorId into inspection, SK, defect and acceptance history (local and cloud). Contractor name, dates and author stay unchanged. Re-runs are safe: already filled rows are skipped; without a card / pending go to “skipped”.
settings.admin.backfill.project.cloud_lo: Cloud unavailable — only local records were processed.
settings.admin.backfill.project.intro: Sets projectId (object node UUID) on inspection / SK / construction history — similar to contractorId. First run SQL sql/011_add_project_id_to_legacy_tables.sql in Supabase.
settings.admin.backfill.project.merge_hi: E.g. “ligovsky 240” → object “Ligovsky 240”: synonym + remap engineer links to UUID.
settings.admin.backfill.project.merge_ne: Enter the spelling and target object
settings.admin.backfill.project.title: Objects · projectId
settings.admin.contractors.confirm_delet: Delete contractor from directory? Inspection history will remain. Contracts will be soft-deleted.
settings.admin.contractors.denied: Contractor directory is available to managers and admins.
settings.admin.contractors.intro: Canonical contractor cards for the project. A stable UUID id is used for future dual-write of inspections. Inspections still write the string name / canonical_key. Legal fields and contracts go to cloud contractors / contracts.
settings.admin.intro: Unified platform admin: directories, request queues, team and permissions. Locations — SoT in “Locations & plans”; engineers are linked to those location UUIDs.
settings.admin.locations.migrate_disable: C2b: Migration Apply disabled — catalog = locations
settings.admin.locations.migrate_hint: Migration Apply is disabled (C2b). Create/edit objects only here. Sync project_objects is off.

Clear selected broken links in the CLOUD?

Records/URLs: {n}
Storage files are not touched (already missing).
Practice/doc/inspection records remain.
settings.admin.orphan.intro: Finds Storage URLs on live practices, docs, and inspections that no longer exist in the bucket. You can clear selected URLs — records themselves are not deleted.
settings.admin.purge.confirm2: Confirm again: hard-delete soft-deleted in the cloud?
settings.admin.purge.intro: Collects cloud records with is_deleted = true (for the current project_code where applicable), counts bucket files and known size, then permanently deletes files and rows. Live data is not affected.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canCreate_hint: Allows creating new inspections / project records. Without the flag the UI is often read-only.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canDeleteAll_h: Can delete others’ records too. Usually admins / deputy managers only.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canDeleteOwn_h: Can delete only own records (author = current engineer). Others — no.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canEditKnowled: Can create and edit knowledge base materials (TWI, docs, nodes, etc.).
settings.admin.roles.bool.canManageHiera: Rights to object hierarchy (building / floor / locations / plans) and related admin directory blocks.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canManageObjec: Admin operations on the object directory / object–user assignments.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canManageRoles: Access to this Roles & permissions screen and permission changes. Caution: removing it from your own role can lock the screen.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canManageSK_hi: Access to manage the SK module (Excel import/analysis), not to be confused with construction control.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canPush_hint: Allows sending local changes to Supabase (sync push). Without the flag data stays on-device only.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canViewKnowled: Can open and read the knowledge base. Without the flag the KB section is hidden.
settings.admin.roles.bool.canViewWeeklyP: Shows the weekly task / engineer plan. Without the flag the section is hidden.
settings.admin.roles.bool.isAdmin_hint: Full admin access in the client: settings admin blocks, bypass some edit limits, admin UI.
settings.admin.roles.bool.isEngineerOrAd: Combined “SK engineer or admin” flag for screens/buttons that need field or full access.
settings.admin.roles.bool.isLeadership_h: Leadership role marker (PM / director / admin). Used in UI and “for leadership” filters.
settings.admin.roles.confirm_reset: Reset permissions for role “{role}” to code defaults?
settings.admin.roles.intro: Changes are currently saved in the admin profile settings (not a company-wide matrix). Role keys (guest…manager) do not change. For rights to apply to engineers/contractors, a separate block is needed: shared matrix + sync distribution; hard RLS in the DB comes later.
settings.admin.roles.key_line: Role key: {key} (not editable — technical name in the user profile)
settings.admin.roles.label: Label
settings.admin.roles.label_hint: Human-readable name in lists (role key stays the same).
settings.admin.roles.module.construction: Construction control module: defects, acceptance, plans, contractor cabinet.
settings.admin.roles.module.quality_hint: Quality module: inspection, history, analytics, tasks, KB and related tabs.
settings.admin.roles.scope.all_hint: Sees all project records without author / contractor / own-object filters.
settings.admin.roles.scope.ownContractor: Only own contractor records (contractor cabinet). Plus project filter if objects are assigned.
settings.admin.roles.scope.ownProjectOrO: Records for own objects; if none — only own records without a project. Typical for engineers.
settings.admin.roles.scope.ownProject_hi: Only records for objects in assignedProjects. If none — empty.
